title: Stack Five ceremonial magic program at Wright Field

tellings.quote: I believe there was a program at right Airfield called stack five st5 and they were doing these kind of bizarre magical protocols ceremonial magic

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says he believes there was a program at Wright Field, a US military airfield, called Stack Five, or ST5. According to Michels, the people in it were carrying out strange magical rituals, what is called ceremonial magic. He tells it because, if true, it would mean the military explored the occult alongside its study of unexplained craft.
